summary: Solid, production-ready code. YAML: pinned actions/checkout@v4, least-privilege permissions, sensible triggers (push/PR/schedule/dispatch), proper error handling. Bash: set -euo pipefail, quoted variables, exit 1 on missing config. Python: well-structured with pure functions, comprehensive docstrings, custom exceptions (ConfigError), type hints on public APIs. Minor gaps: _parse_date(value, field) and _parse_policy(value) lack value type hints (lines ~97, ~111); _json_default (line ~140) lacks type hint. Workflow runs validator 3 times (lines ~47-49, 51-53, 55-57) to generate markdown/json/summary—not false, but could optimize to single run + conditional outputs. Excellent error handling, validation, and separation of concerns offset these minor issues.
